title.tl: Inihahanda Ko ang Sarili para sa Salah

text.ar: افترض الله على المسلم في اليوم والليلة خمس صلوات وهي: الفجر والظهر والعصر والمغرب والعشاء.
text.en: Allah ordained upon the Muslim five prayers in the day and night; they are: Fajr (dawn) prayer, Dhuhr (noon) prayer, ‘Asr (afternoon) prayer, Maghrib (sunset) prayer and ‘Isha’ (night) prayer.
text.tl: Inobliga ng Allah ang limang beses na pagdarasal sa bawat araw at ito ay ang mga sumusunod: Ang Fajr, Dhuhur, Asar, Maghrib at Isha.

text.ar:
إذا دخل وقت الصلاة يتطهَّر المسلم من الحدث الأصغر والحدث الأكبر، إذا كان محدثًا حدثًا أكبر.
الحدث الأكبر هو: ما يُوجب على المسلم الغُسل.
الحدث الأصغر هو: ما يُوجب على المسلم الوضوء.
text.en:
When the time of prayer starts, the Muslim purifies himself from the state of minor impurity, and from major impurity if he is in a state of major impurity.
Major impurity is what requires Ghusl (ritual bath).
Minor impurity is what requires Wudu’ (ablution).
text.tl:
Kapag pumasok ang oras ng salah marapat na maging malinis ang isang muslim mula sa estado ng maliit at malaking karumihan.
(estado ng malaking karumihan): nangangailangan ng Ghusl (buong paghuhugas o pagligo).
(estado ng maliit na karumihan): nangangailangan ng Wudhu.

text.ar:
يصلي المسلم بملابسَ طاهرةً في مكان طاهر من النجاسات ساترًا عورته.
يتزين المسلم بملابس لائقة وقت الصلاة ويستر جسده بها، ولا يجوز للرجل في الصلاة أن يبدي شيئًا مما بين السرة والركبة.
يجب على المرأة أن تستر جميع بدنها في الصلاة إلا الوجه والكفين.
text.en:
The Muslim prays in a clean place free of impurities, wearing clean clothes that conceal his ‘Awra (a must covered body parts).
A Muslim wears proper clothing which covers his body in prayer. A man is not allowed to pray with the area between his navel and knees uncovered.
The woman must cover her whole body in prayer except for her face and hands.
text.tl:
Ang isang Muslim ay nagdarasal sa dalisay na lugar na may dalisay na damit na natatakpan ang kanyang Awra (maseselang bahagi ng katawan). Ang isang Muslim ay nagsusuot nang mabuti at maayos na damit na tumatakip sa kanyang katawan sa salah, at hindi maari na ipakita sa salah ang bahagi ng kanyang awra at ito ay sa pagitan ng pusod at tuhod para sa mga kalalakihan.
Dapat takpan ng isang babae ang kanyang buong katawan maliban sa mukha at mga kamay.

text.ar: لا يتحدث المسلم في الصلاة بغير الأقوال الخاصة بها، وينصت إلى الإمام، ولا يلتفت في صلاته، وإن عجز عن حفظ الأقوال الخاصة بالصلاة فإنه يذكر الله ويسبِّحه حتى ينتهي من الصلاة، ويلزمه المبادرة إلى تعلُّم الصلاة وأقوالها.
text.en: While performing Salah, the Muslim only says the words relevant to Salah, he listens to the Imam (the person leading the congregational prayer), and he does not turn left or right in Salah. If he is unable to memorize the words of Salah, he should mention Allah and glorify Him until the prayer ends. He is required to hasten to learn Salah and its words.
text.tl: Hindi marapat sa isang muslim na magsalita habang nagsasalah maliban sa mga salita na bibigkasin para sa salah, makinig sa Imam at hindi maaaring lumingon habang nagsasalah. Kung hindi pa kabisado an mga salita na bibigkasin sa salah, marapat na kanyang gawin na lamang ay magdhikr o alalahanin at luwalhatiin ang Allah hanngang sa matapos ang salah. Nararapat lamang na magmadali na pag-aralan ang paraan ng salah at mga salita na dapat bigkasin dito.

text.ar: يعرف الصلوات الخمس التي افترضها الله في اليوم والليلة
text.en: Knows the five prayers Allah ordained in the day and night
text.tl: Alam ang limang Salah na inobliga ng Allah sa bawat araw

text.ar: يفرّق بين الحدث الأكبر والحدث الأصغر
text.en: Tells major impurity apart from minor impurity
text.tl: Natutukoy ang pagkakaiba ng malaki at maliit na karumihan

text.ar: يعرف ما يلبسه في الصلاة وأين يصلي وما يستره الرجل والمرأة
text.en: Knows what to wear for prayer, where to pray, and what a man and a woman must cover
text.tl: Alam ang dapat isuot sa Salah, kung saan magdarasal, at ang dapat takpan ng lalaki at babae

text.ar: يعرف آداب الصلاة، وما يفعله إن لم يحفظ أقوالها بعد
text.en: Knows how to behave in prayer, and what to do if he has not yet memorised its words
text.tl: Alam ang wastong asal sa Salah, at ang gagawin kung hindi pa kabisado ang mga salita nito

notes: The PRD gives pp. 90–92; the first card (the five daily prayers) is the opening sentence of the prayer section just before «أتهيأ للصلاة», included so no sentence is lost. Card 4 carries the book's reassurance used by LRN-01 rule 2/4 (remember and glorify Allah until the words are learned); in English the transliterated "Subhān Allah" was dropped. In Filipino the terms "Hadath Akbar/Asghar" (Arabic phrases in Latin letters) were dropped; the Filipino gloss in brackets stays.
